jobs.title: Assistant Professor or Instructor (Engineering), Department of Chemistry Physics, and Engineering
jobs.description: Assistant Professor or Instructor (Engineering), Department of Chemistry Physics, and Engineering LinkedIn Twitter Email Message Share Faculty Lawton, OK • ID: F1273B • Full-Time/Regular Job Description: Assistant Professor or Instructor (Engineering), Department of Chemistry Physics, and Engineering (F1273B) The Department of Chemistry, Physics and Engineering at Cameron University invites applications for an assistant professor or instructor (Engineering) position beginning in the Fall of 2026. The Department has 7 full time faculty members and offers programs leading to BS degrees in Chemistry (including ACS Certified), an AAS in Engineering in five different concentrations, and a new BS degree in Mechanical Engineering. The successful candidate will be responsible for teaching upper and lower division engineering coursework for the new engineering program as well as general education courses (including the online format). The Engineering program has several 3D printers and a maker space for project builds. Responsibilities for the position also include accomplishing scholarly activity such as undergraduate research and service work. SUPERVISION: The position will report to the chairperson of the Department of Chemistry, Physics and Engineering. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: MS in Engineering or related field from a regionally accredited university. PREFERED QUALIFICATIONS: Ph.D. in Engineering from a regionally accredited university and prior undergraduate teaching experience. INSTITUTION: Cameron University (www.cameron.edu) is a state-supported regional institution located in Lawton, Oklahoma, that offers undergraduate and graduate degrees. Dedicated to excellence, the university provides a wide range of economic, cultural, and educational opportunities for the betterment of all citizens. Master’s-level graduate degrees are offered in business, behavioral sciences and education; baccalaureate programs are offered in more than forty disciplines, and associate degrees are offered in many other studies. The close proximity of Fort Sill contributes to an area rich in cultural diversity and provides the opportunity for many cooperative efforts. The combined community of Lawton/Fort Sill has a population of more than 100,000 and is located adjacent to the picturesque Wichita Mountains Wildlife Refuge. A copy of the University’s Annual Security Report, listing crime statistics and university policies, is available by contacting the Office of Public Safety or by accessing the report online at www.cameron.edu/ops. APPLYING: Attachments should include a cover letter indicating experience applicable to position, resume, transcripts (unofficial are acceptable at this point), names, addresses, and telephone numbers of three professional references. jobs.title: Cosmetology Master Instructor - Foundations
jobs.description: Cosmetology Master Instructor - FoundationsClary Sage College - Tulsa, OK 74145OverviewPosition TypeFull TimeEducation LevelHigh SchoolCategoryEducationDescriptionMinimum Requirements: Current Oklahoma Cosmetology Master Educator License, dual licensure as both a Cosmetology and Barber Instructor preferred, a minimum of three years of verified industry experience. The schedule for this position is: Monday - Thursday, Evenings 12:00 p.m. to 10:30 p.m. Duties & Responsibilities This instructor will lead students through the Milady Foundations curriculum with a focus on scientific concepts, theory understanding, and essential business skills. Teaching Responsibilities: Teach the Milady Foundations curriculum, including theory, scientific principles, safety and sanitation, professionalism, and introductory business concepts. Counsel students in a professional manner, offering encouraging, constructive, and timely feedback. Adhere to curriculum expectations to ensure accreditation standards are met. Proactively identify and address issues with course content, materials, or classroom technology. Send welcome emails to students on your roster two days before the scheduled start of class. Respond to written assignments with personalized comments and support. Model the CARES philosophy and core values through courage, teamwork, perseverance, and vision. Provide clear instruction on scientific concepts such as anatomy, chemistry fundamentals, electricity, infection control, and product knowledge. Teach foundational business skills including communication, customer service, goal planning, retail basics, professionalism, and workplace readiness. Maintain current knowledge of industry trends and foundational theory updates. Assist students with basic study skills, note taking, comprehension strategies, and academic success habits. Perform instructional assistance and tutoring as needed to support student understanding. Adhere to OSHA standards and maintain compliance in theory classrooms. Encourage students to stay positive, professional, and motivated as they enter the beauty industry. Maintain accurate documentation of grades and attendance and enter records in Canvas. Prepare students for future state board requirements by building strong theory comprehension and milestone competency. Keep classroom areas organized, sanitized, and stocked with learning materials. Order classroom supplies as needed and assist with inventory. Be familiar with Oklahoma State Board rules and other accrediting requirements that relate to foundational education. Support student retention by monitoring attendance, reviewing completion of learning activities, and contacting students as needed. Maintain a high performance environment that supports structure, accountability, and student success. Effort and Commitment Displays a high level of effort and commitment to all responsibilities. Operates effectively within the organizational structure and demonstrates responsible behavior. Shows eagerness to learn and accepts growing responsibilities. Displays a positive approach to work and persists through challenges. Works resourcefully within system expectations and adapts to new procedures. Accepts feedback from supervisors and follows through appropriately. Works scheduled hours, arrives on time, follows attendance procedures, and uses work time appropriately. Other Attend all graduation ceremonies Participate in school sponsored activities Complete a minimum of two professional developments and two in-service meetings annually. QualificationsQualifications: Foundations Instructors should have a natural talent for teaching, strong communication skills, and patience. They must be able to break down scientific concepts in a clear and supportive way while making theory engaging and relevant.
